name: tumtum
description: Tumtum, a huge fat green orc with a big round belly, two white tusks jutting up from his underbite, a black topknot tied with an orange band, a necklace of bone teeth and brown leather straps with iron rings across his bare green chest, raising a big brown wooden club studded with bone-white spikes in his RIGHT hand, riding a big brown bristly boar with a dark spiky mane along its back, a red eye, a pink snout and long curved white tusks, its head toward the lower-right
hands: the spiked club stays in the orc's right hand on the screen-left side and his left hand rests as an empty fist on the boar's back on the screen-right side

death.6: bounce: the orc's shoulders lift a hair and the boar's head and tusks lift a little off the ground
death.7: corpses: the boar lying still, collapsed on its belly with its tusked head on the ground, the orc slumped forward over its neck, eyes closed, the spiked club on the ground beside the head
